# Miami Elio

> Miami Elio, by Gorgona One, is a luxury rentals, bookings and ELIO+ Guide platform for Miami. ELIO works in 16 languages. It covers yacht charters, exotic car rentals, villa and hotel bookings, private jet charters, curated experiences, concert, sports and VIP event tickets, and restaurants and nightlife. It is not a real estate sales site and not a retail store.

Website: https://gorgona-one.com
Phone: +1 786-492-8880
WhatsApp Business: https://wa.me/message/VO7GCPZCDKRZO1
Telegram Business: https://t.me/MIAMI_ELIO

Many listings come from partners. Quotes, bookings and payments for those listings are handled by the partner named on each page.

## Main sections

- [ELIO+ Guide — Discovery Room](https://gorgona-one.com/discovery): 16-language AI guide (ELIO) for Miami itineraries, venue comparisons, live NOAA weather planning and direct booking cards.
- [Yacht charters](https://gorgona-one.com/yachts): Charter yachts in Miami through a partner catalogue.
- [Exotic and luxury car rentals](https://gorgona-one.com/rentals): Cars available to rent in Miami, with a page for each vehicle.
- [Villas and vacation rentals](https://gorgona-one.com/vacation-rentals): Villas and stays in Miami.
- [Private jets](https://gorgona-one.com/private-jets): Request a private jet charter quote through a partner.
- [Experiences](https://gorgona-one.com/experiences): Tours, attractions and tickets in Miami and across Florida.
- [Event tickets](https://gorgona-one.com/events): Sports and concert tickets.
- [Restaurants and nightlife](https://gorgona-one.com/restaurants-nightlife): Restaurants, clubs and rooftops in Miami.
- [Exclusive destinations](https://gorgona-one.com/exclusive-destinations): Private yachts, cruises, helicopter flights and hand-picked tours.
- [Travel and flight deals](https://gorgona-one.com/travel): Business, first-class and Miami flight offers.
